test_commit_scheduler: test the CommitScheduler class that periodically syncs a local folder to a Hugging Face Hub repo
test_partial_file_io: test the PartialFileIO class that reads a truncated view of a file up to a size limit
test_sync_local_folder: test syncing a local folder with text and binary files to a remote Hugging Face Hub repo on a schedule
test_sync_and_squash_history: test squashing multiple scheduled commits into a single commit on the Hugging Face Hub
test_context_manager: test using CommitScheduler as a context manager that auto-stops on exit and pushes pending files
